title: Workflow economy clean authority cutover design

items.label: The written design maps every item in the user-provided twenty-item brief to one bounded rule.
items.verificationNote: The Source Brief table maps items 1 through 20 individually to bounded design decisions.

items.label: The design requires one atomic cutover and prohibits simultaneous current old and new authority.
items.evidenceTarget: Clean Authority Cutover section of the written design
items.verificationNote: The design keeps existing authority current before cutover, requires all entrypoints to switch at one gate, and permits only the replacement authority afterward.

items.label: The user reviews and approves the written design before implementation planning.
items.evidenceTarget: User review decision in the current PLAN task
